title: Largan chairman casts doubt on Micro LED links for AI data centers
summary: Largan Precision chairman En-ping Lin has questioned the viability of Micro LED-based optical links for AI data centers, citing concerns over power consumption, size, and transmission efficiency. title: Microsoft adds US$132.5 billion in lease commitments—but AI capacity takes years to build
summary: Microsoft's lease commitments that have not yet commenced reached US$329.1 billion in the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, which ended in June, according to its latest regulatory filing.
